subject.title: macOS chat window: native redesign with sessions sidebar, toolbar pickers, slash commands, context usage

question: Should OpenClaw accept the native macOS chat shell direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101103 for this issue, or narrow/defer parts of the redesign?
rationale: The request is a broad protected macOS UX and transport-surface change with an open maintainer PR; automation should not decide the product/design scope.

options.title: Review and land the linked Mac shell PR
options.body: Accept the NavigationSplitView sidebar, toolbar, slash-command, context-usage, and Mac transport API direction through the open implementation PR after normal review.

options.title: Narrow the first PR
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask the PR to split lower-confidence pieces such as export, compact, or sidebar management into follow-ups.

options.title: Defer the redesign
options.body: Leave current main as-is and keep the issue as a product backlog item if the native shell direction is not ready.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked Mac shell PR
recommendation.body: Accept the NavigationSplitView sidebar, toolbar, slash-command, context-usage, and Mac transport API direction through the open implementation PR after normal review.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the tracker and owns the current open implementation PR for the requested macOS shell work.
